name: Kabe no Mukou no Tsuma no Koe 2 ~Tonari de Hageshiku Koshi o Furu Asedaku no Tsuma wa, Zecchou no Hate ni Hakudakujiru o Sosogare Midara na Ikigao o Joushi ni Miseru~
original_name: 壁の向こうの妻の嬌声２ ～隣で激しく腰を振る汗だくの妻は、絶頂の果てに白濁汁を注がれ淫らなイキ顔を上司に魅せる～
source:
The apartment where the protagonist and his wife live was caught on fire. So until they can find a new home, they will have to live with his boss' family for while.

Because they can't have sex in another person house, the protagonist is a little bit sexually frustrated. One day, his boss confesses that he has erectile dysfunction​ and asks him to sleep with his wife.

And thus, the swapping story begins.

[Translated from [url=http://www.hs-crowd.co.jp/anim/product/pro_pc/pc048/introduce.html]Official Site[/url]]
translation:
主人公和妻子居住的公寓着火了。在找到新家之前，他们只能暂时住进老板家。

由于不能在别人家里做爱，主人公感到有些性饥渴。某天，老板坦白自己勃起功能障碍，请求主人公和他的妻子上床。

交换故事就此开始。
